name: LINE WORKS
description: Business connector for LINE WORKS (API 2.0) through one bot, authenticated as the app's service account. Read-only by default: information and members of the configured channels (LINE WORKS has no API to read message history). Sending a message to a configured channel or user is a separate opt-in and always needs a person's approval.

clientId.description: Client ID of the app in the LINE WORKS Developer Console. The client secret goes in the secret store: connector.line-works.clientSecret.

serviceAccount.description: Service Account id of the app (e.g. abcde.serviceaccount@example). Its private key goes in the secret store: connector.line-works.privateKey.

botId.description: Bot id of the bot registered for the app.

channels.description: Channel ids the bot may read information about and (with write.send) post to.

users.description: User ids the bot may message (with write.send).

send.description: Allow sending text messages (bot.message) to the configured channels and users. Every message needs a person's approval.
